originalTitle: Wall St rises on the day but falls for the week; bond yields and Iran in focus
summary: STORY: U.S. stock indexes closed higher Friday with the Dow gaining about 1 percent and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq rising about four-tenths of one percent each. :: Archive All three fell for the week as investors were rattled by fluctuating government bond yields and a lack of clarity on progress in the Middle East. Friday’s economic data eased concerns, as the U.S. services sector posted its strongest growth in nearly two years powering a sharp acceleration in overall business activity in August. This offset a slowing of growth in a manufacturing sector that is being restrained by reduced stock building and supply disruptions from the Iran war. Earlier, UBS Global Wealth Management raised its year-end target for the S&P 500 to 8,100, citing a stronger earnings outlook and robust corporate profit growth. Kevin Mahn, president and chief investment officer with Hennion & Walsh Asset Management says he expects a bumpy road for stocks in the near term but believes they will finish 2026 on solid footing. "So I believe that the market is likely headed for more short-term bouts of volatility up to and through these midterm elections." // "But I also believe that once we have some clarity after the midterm elections, in all likelihood, some type of lasting deal between the US and Iran, moderating inflation, and also continued strong earnings, not just from technology companies, but all S&P 500 companies will have a very strong close to the year. " Stocks on the move included Ross Stores which added 4 percent after the value retailer raised its annual profit forecasts and reported better-than-expected quarterly results. And retail investor platform Robinhood surged nearly 14% as bitcoin touched its highest levels since mid-May.

chineseTitle: 华尔街当日上涨，但当周下跌；债券收益率和伊朗成为焦点
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股指周五收高，道指上涨约 1%，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数分别上涨约十分之四，即 1%。 :: Archive 由于政府债券收益率波动和中东进展缺乏明确性，投资者感到不安，这三者本周均下跌。周五的经济数据缓解了人们的担忧，美国服务业录得近两年来最强劲的增长，推动 8 月份整体商业活动急剧加速。这抵消了制造业增长放缓的影响，制造业因库存减少和伊朗战争造成的供应中断而受到限制。此前，瑞银全球财富管理将标准普尔 500 指数的年终目标上调至 8,100 点，理由是盈利前景更加强劲，企业利润增长强劲。 Hennion & Walsh Asset Management 总裁兼首席投资官凯文·马恩 (Kevin Mahn) 表示，他预计近期股市走势将崎岖不平，但相信 2026 年股市将站稳脚跟。 “因此，我认为，在中期选举之前和期间，市场可能会出现更多短期波动。” //“但我也相信，一旦中期选举后我们有了一些明确的认识，美国和伊朗之间很可能会达成某种持久的协议，缓和通货膨胀，并且持续强劲的盈利，不仅来自科技公司，而且所有标准普尔 500 指数公司都将在年底表现强劲。” 受此影响的股票包括罗斯商店 (Ross Stores)，在这家价值零售商上调年度利润预测并公布好于预期的季度业绩后，该公司股价上涨 4%。随着比特币触及 5 月中旬以来的最高水平，散户投资者平台 Robinhood 飙升近 14%。
